semantic_contract: value 0 logs the single-tap event and emits single_tap=true
value 1 logs the double-tap event and emits double_tap=true
value 2 logs the pen-capacity event and emits pen_capacity_low=true
other byte values log the unknown event and emit no uevent
the uevent target is the platform-device kobject at tpd_cdev + 0xdd0 + 16
the uevent action is 2 and the environment is one terminated string
follow_up_required: Reduce the candidate unknown-value path by one branch or otherwise match the stock 260-byte layout before claiming byte-level equivalence.
unverified: the physical touchscreen controller and kernel uevent subsystem
full module integration and boot behavior
decision_basis: Ghidra pseudocode/P-Code, Joern strict gate, reproducible Docker build, two-cycle host sanitizer harness, exact KCFI type ID, normalized AArch64 dispatch and external-call evidence. No smartphone test was performed.
